title: 7 Days & 6 Nights Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 7 Days Yoga Retreat In Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Step into your zen zone with the best 7-Day Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali by Bali Yoga School. Enjoy authentic yoga sessions, pranayama, meditation, and detox therapies in a serene retreat surrounded by lush gardens, pools, and spiritual energy. Perfect for all levels seeking rejuvenation.
summary: A 7 days & 6 nights yoga retreat in Uluwatu with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, healing sessions and 6 complimentary Balinese massages.
intro: Step into your zen zone with a transformative 7-day yoga journey in the breathtaking coastal paradise of Uluwatu, Bali. Known for its stunning cliffs, golden beaches, and soothing ocean breeze, Uluwatu sets the perfect scene for deep relaxation and self-discovery.

Each day begins with rejuvenating yoga and pranayama sessions followed by guided meditation, detox therapies, and soulful Hatha Vinyasa flow practices. You’ll also enjoy healing experiences including sound therapy, reiki sessions, and traditional Balinese massages to help you unwind and restore inner balance.

Whether you are a beginner or an experienced practitioner, our experienced teachers blend ancient yogic wisdom with modern teaching methods to guide you toward physical vitality and mental clarity. In your free time, explore Uluwatu’s nearby beaches, ocean temples, surf spots, and hidden cafes — each offering a taste of Bali’s vibrant culture and natural beauty.

items: In order to book for retreat kindly deposit the Advance booking amount of 150 USD. Balance should be paid on arrival either by card, cash or Online transfer. An official confirmation letter concerning your program will be sent to you shortly after successful advance booking fee.
